candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its POST /v1/orders call to the order service fails with transport errors at ~2s, indicating downstream order-service latency/timeout rather than a gateway fault.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-service-side logs/metrics not observed; whether the ~2s is a client timeout or order-service slowness is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Gateway logs show repeated 502 on /v1/checkout paired with transport errors calling order at ~2s, while /readyz stays 200; metrics show 16 502s and p95 ~2425ms on checkout. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. Root cause is downstream of gateway but the specific slow hop is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/metrics for POST /v1/orders latency and errors
Order service dependency (inventory/payment/postgresql) latency metrics to localize the slow hop
Gateway client timeout configuration to confirm ~2s is a timeout threshold
